items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: I never forgot about the first music I had was when I had made up a band. Me and Paul Villar... Paul Villar, Edgar, Edgar Briscoe.

ctx.x: Yeah. That's all it would buy for us. That's why we all had to play that. Yeah.

I started playing Bohem system. How did you like the Bohem system? Oh, I never forgot about the first music I had was when I had made up a band. Me and Paul Villar, half of them guys half dead. Was that a dance band or a brass band? A jazz band. A jazz band. Jazz band, yeah. Paul Villar, Edgar, Edgar Briscoe. Edgar Briscoe used to play guitar, huh? Who?
